spec.ticket_text:
Bug: there is no way to list issues across projects

Steps: sign in as member@acme.test and try to find every open, high-priority issue assigned to you.
Expected: one request, GET /issues?status=open&priority=high&assignee_id=<your id>, returns them from
every project in your org, paged with cursor and limit.
Actual: the endpoint does not exist; you have to page through GET /projects/{project_id}/issues for
each project.

Notes: filters are status, priority, assignee_id, project_id, and q (title contains, any case, 1-100
characters), combined with AND. Deleted issues and issues of archived projects must not appear. A
project_id or assignee_id of another org should give 404 not_found, an invalid value 422
validation_error. Any role may read; items are IssueOut. Spec: docs/features/f1.md.
